summary: The code is mostly correct and would compile, using Playwright APIs appropriately with correct awaits. The testCaseIds are preserved in titles and all GENERATED tests are present. However, selectors rely on assumed roles and generic elements without solid evidence. Navigation validation is weak and could cause false positives. Assertions and locator usage are proper. No hard-coded waits or placeholder URLs are present.

issues.description: Selectors heavily rely on assumed ARIA roles such as 'grid' and 'gridcell' which may not be defined in the application, risking test instability.
issues.recommendation: Confirm roles exist or use more explicit selectors with stable attributes or testids.

issues.description: Selectors depend on generic tags like 'h2' and class '.price' without context, which may select unexpected elements.
issues.recommendation: Refine selectors to be more specific and robust, for example by using data-testid attributes or unique classes.

issues.description: The product detail page navigation test validates URL and title with generic regex and text, which may lead to false positives.
issues.recommendation: Use more precise URL patterns and check for unique elements on the product detail page to ensure correct navigation.

recommendations: Add explicit waits for navigation after clicking the product link for more stable tests.
Introduce data-testid attributes in the application to improve selectors and reduce dependency on fragile ARIA roles.
Enhance navigation assertions by verifying page-specific elements beyond URL and title.
